response.justification: While the candidate possesses extensive and diverse software development experience, they do not meet the critical mandatory requirements for this role. Specifically, the resume shows very limited hands-on C++ experience, far short of the 5-10 years required, and lacks direct domain expertise in Fixed Income or Capital Markets systems. Although strong in general software craftsmanship, these core mismatches make them unsuitable for this particular position.
strengths: Extensive and diverse software development experience across various technologies.
Strong communication skills demonstrated through workshops and talks.
Proficiency in CI/CD practices and modern software craftsmanship.
concerns: Very limited hands-on C++ experience, not meeting the 5-10 year requirement for the role.
No specific experience in Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking systems.
Lack of demonstrated strong SQL experience with SQL Server or Oracle as specified.
